title: Triggers
description: One place for all three automation trigger types - directory watch, cron schedules and webhooks - with rules, plans and unified trigger history.
table.name: Name
empty.title: No trigger rules yet
empty.description: Create a rule to monitor a directory and process incoming files automatically.
delete.title: Delete rule
delete.message: Delete trigger rule "{{name}}"? Watched files will no longer be processed. This action cannot be undone.
toggle.disabledHint: Disabled rules are skipped by the watch loop
history.title: Trigger history
dialog.name: Name
dialog.watchDirHint: Absolute path. Windows: F:\watch or \\nas\share; Linux/macOS: /data/watch. The directory may not exist yet; a warning is logged until it appears.
dialog.extensionsHint: Comma separated. Dots are stripped and values lowercased. Leave empty to accept all files.
dialog.recursiveHint: Recursively scan subdirectories under the watch directory.
dialog.includeModifiedHint: When off, only new files trigger; changes to already-seen files never trigger.
dialog.stabilityHint: A file must stay unchanged for this long before it triggers (minimum 5s). Prevents half-written downloads.
dialog.backfillHint: When on, files already in the directory are processed oldest-first. When off, only files arriving after creation trigger.
dialog.enabledHint: Disabled rules are skipped by the watch loop.
dialog.mode.archiveDesc: Copy matching files to the output directory with the naming template. No module or pipeline needed.
dialog.mode.moduleDesc: Run a module capability on each file, then archive the result.
dialog.mode.pipelineDesc: Submit the selected pipeline with the file injected at the chosen input node.
dialog.inputNodeNone: This pipeline has no file input node
dialog.inputNodeHint: Files are injected at the selected file_input node.
dialog.outputHint: Matched files (or direct-action results) are delivered to the output directory with the naming template.
validation.watchDirInvalid: Enter an absolute path (Windows: F:\watch or \\nas\share; Linux/macOS: /data/watch)
validation.pipelineRequired: Select a pipeline and input node
validation.destDirInvalid: Enter an absolute path (Windows: F:\output or \\nas\share; Linux/macOS: /data/output)
validation.pathOverlap: Watch directory and destination directory are the same or nested; archived products would re-enter the watch directory and retrigger. Use two separate directories
events.title: Unified event history
events.filter.label: Type
sched.pipelineHint: The selected pipeline is submitted automatically on cron hits (shared with the pipeline editor's schedule dialog).
sched.cronHint: Five fields (local timezone), e.g. 0 3 * * * = daily at 03:00.
sched.emptyDescription: Attach a cron plan to a pipeline and it will be submitted automatically.
sched.deleteMessage: Remove the schedule for pipeline "{{id}}"? The pipeline itself is unaffected.
hook.name: Name
hook.mode.pipelineDesc: POST /api/hooks/{id} submits the selected pipeline using the template.
hook.mode.directDesc: POST /api/hooks/{id} runs the selected module capability directly (module auto-start).
hook.pipelineHint: Callers may override the inputs template per request.
hook.inputPathPlaceholder: e.g. store:media/incoming or a physical path
hook.inputPathHint: Accepts a store reference (store:name/relative) or a server physical path.
hook.copyHint: Click to copy the trigger URL (POST)
hook.emptyDescription: Create a webhook, then POST /api/hooks/{id} from external systems to trigger a pipeline or direct run.
hook.deleteMessage: Delete webhook "{{name}}"? External calls will fail immediately. This cannot be undone.
hook.validation.inputPathRequired: Direct target requires an input path
